books.label: Isacord 40
books.sourceNote: Number/name/RGB from AMANN Group's official 'RGB values for ISACORD 40 (390 colours)' chart (rev 12/2021, mirrored by advancedscreenprintsupply.com); thread numbers independently corroborated by the Zlib-licensed Embroidermodder/libembroidery Isacord table (303 of its 318 numbers match; RGB is a screen approximation and varies between sources).

books.label: Madeira Polyneon 40
books.sourceNote: Names from Madeira USA's official 'Polyneon ColorNames2015' PDF (spot-verified against madeirausa.com product pages incl. 1500 Black Blue, 1800 Emerald Black); hex sampled as median pixel of each swatch in Madeira's official 2017 Polyneon colour-card PDF - photographic swatches, so very light shades (e.g. 1801-1805 whites) read darker than the real thread; 20 Multicolor variegated threads (1510-1519, 1600-1609) and special 2800 excluded.
